info.title: Jobicy Remote Jobs API
info.description: Public and Commercial Jobs API for current remote listings, with cursor pagination over a 7-day publication window. Includes location and category taxonomy lookups. All examples contain illustrative job data. This specification covers the Jobs API; the Salary API, MCP server, RSS feed, and widget are separate interfaces. Batch status lookup checks stored job IDs independently of the seven-day feed.

externalDocs.description: Jobicy Jobs API documentation and playground

get.summary: Retrieve remote jobs or filter taxonomies
get.description:
Retrieve matching remote job listings published within the last 7 days. The same endpoint serves public and Commercial Jobs API requests, plus location and category taxonomies.

Public access requires no API key. Public job URLs point to Jobicy; preserve attribution and the returned source URL. For Commercial access, obtain an API key at https://jobicy.com/api-dashboard and send Authorization: Bearer API_KEY on every request. Commercial access returns original application URLs when available. Each direct-link job costs USD 0.01 once per API key; repeat retrievals for the same key and jobs without a direct application URL are free. Commercial GET requests can debit the API wallet.

Cursor pagination:
1. Start without cursor, using count and any geo, industry, and tag filters.
2. Pass each response's nextCursor back as cursor, unchanged and URL-encoded.
3. Keep geo, industry, and tag unchanged between pages. The count can change within 1-200.
4. Stop when nextCursor is null and hasMore is false. Deduplicate stored jobs by id.

Ordering is publication time in UTC descending, then job ID descending. The upper publication boundary is fixed at the start of a traversal; the lower boundary is checked on each request, so listings older than 7 days can drop out during pagination. There is no separate total-record cap within this window. Cursors expire 24 hours after the first request; subsequent pages do not renew them. An invalid or expired cursor, or changed filters, returns HTTP 400. Start a fresh traversal without cursor to discover new jobs.

For taxonomy values, use get=locations or get=industries. Taxonomy queries return a different response shape and do not support cursor. Use returned geoSlug and industrySlug values for job filters rather than guessing slugs. Deprecated industry aliases are accepted: dev -> engineering, e-commerce -> management, video-audio-production -> design-multimedia, translation-localization -> copywriting, smm -> marketing.

Synchronize no more frequently than once per hour; sequential page requests within one synchronization pass are allowed. Cache public responses appropriately. A job leaving the 7-day feed does not imply that it has closed. To check stored listings, call GET /api/v2/remote-jobs/status with up to 100 comma-separated Jobicy IDs. The status endpoint returns active, closed, or unknown without applying the publication window and never charges for status checks. Unknown is not confirmation of closure.

Only the documented query parameters below are part of this public contract. Unknown parameters and array-form query values are rejected. Salary fields and company images may be unavailable; handle them without assuming a complete employer profile.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum jobs per page. Default 200; use 100 for smaller responses. The implementation clamps integer values to 1-200 rather than rejecting out-of-range integers. A non-integer value returns HTTP 400. Ignored for taxonomy queries.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the previous jobs response. Omit for the first page. URL-encode and pass unchanged alongside the same geo, industry, and tag filters. Valid for 24 hours from the start of traversal; not accepted with get=locations or get=industries. A cursor is not an API key.

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: One geographic eligibility slug, such as usa, europe, apac, or anywhere. Discover values using get=locations. This parameter does not accept ISO country codes or a list of countries. Ignored for taxonomy queries.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: One job category slug. Discover values using get=industries. Legacy aliases are accepted and reported through replacement headers. Ignored for taxonomy queries.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Keyword search across available job content. Accepted length is 3-50 bytes after trimming and stripping HTML, as enforced by PHP strlen; for ASCII queries this is 3-50 characters. This is a text query, not a structured skill identifier. Ignored for taxonomy queries.

parameters.name: get
parameters.description: Return a taxonomy instead of jobs. Omit for the jobs feed. Taxonomy responses contain locations or industries plus appliedFilters, without jobs metadata. Do not combine with cursor. Other feed filters are ignored in taxonomy mode.

200.description: Successful jobs feed, location taxonomy, or category taxonomy response. The shape depends on the get parameter. An empty jobs array is a successful response.

Cache-Control.description: Public responses may be cached for 3600 seconds. Authorized responses are private and must not be stored.

X-Jobicy-API-Cache.description: Diagnostic cache status emitted by the application. Do not rely on it for pagination.

Vary.description: Authorized responses include Authorization as a varying request header.

X-Jobicy-Deprecated-Industry.description: Legacy industry slug when an alias was used.

X-Jobicy-Replacement-Industry.description: Canonical industry slug replacing the legacy alias.

publicFinalPage.description: Illustrative job data. Request without get, using count=100, geo=usa, and industry=engineering. nextCursor=null ends pagination.

400.description: Invalid query parameters, an unsupported filter, or an invalid, altered, expired, or filter-mismatched cursor. The cursor is not accepted with taxonomy queries. Restart without cursor after a cursor error.

Cursor does not match the filters. Keep geo, industry and tag unchanged.

The 'count' parameter must be a number.

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limiting can be enforced by infrastructure outside the PHP endpoint, so the response body and headers can vary. Respect Retry-After when present, otherwise use exponential backoff. Do not start a new cursor traversal for each retry.

Retry-After.description: If provided, wait for the indicated number of seconds or HTTP date before retrying.

get.summary: Check a batch of stored job IDs
get.description: Check 1-100 Jobicy job IDs, including jobs older than seven days. No cursor or feed filters are accepted. Duplicate IDs produce one result in first-occurrence order; the limit counts supplied values before duplicate removal. IDs must be positive integers no greater than 9007199254740991. Unknown means the public status cannot be confirmed, not that the vacancy definitely closed. Status checks return no descriptions or ATS links. Public access needs no API key. A supplied Bearer key is validated with the same account, expiry, and IP rules as the feed, but no job credits or wallet balance are consumed. Start routine status synchronization hourly or less frequently; sequential batches in a pass are allowed. Public responses may be cached for 60 seconds; authorized responses are private and not stored. This is the Jobicy listing state, not a live probe of the employer ATS.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated positive Jobicy job IDs. Do not send ids[] or feed parameters. Surrounding whitespace is ignored; empty values, signs, leading zeros, decimal numbers, and exponent notation are rejected.

200.description: One status per unique requested ID. Missing or non-public IDs are returned as unknown in a successful HTTP 200 response.

mixedStatuses.summary: Illustrative active, closed, and unknown results

authorizedFreeCheck.summary: Authorized status check with no charge

400.description: Missing/empty ids, invalid positive integers, array-form input, more than 100 supplied values (before deduplication), or unsupported query parameters. No partial result is returned for invalid input.

401.description: The optional Authorization header or API key is invalid, revoked, or expired.

403.description: The supplied Commercial API account is banned or the client IP is not permitted.

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limiting can be enforced by infrastructure outside the PHP endpoint, so the response body and headers can vary. Respect Retry-After when present, otherwise use exponential backoff. Do not start a new cursor traversal for each retry.

Retry-After.description: If provided, wait for the indicated number of seconds or HTTP date before retrying.

500.description: Job status retrieval or authorized request logging failed.

CommercialApiKey.description: Optional Commercial Jobs API key issued by the Jobicy API Dashboard. Send Authorization: Bearer API_KEY on every page. Public requests require no authorization. This is an opaque API key, not a JWT. Supplying a key can debit the API wallet for new direct-link jobs.

id.description: Unique Jobicy listing ID. Deduplicate stored listings using this value.

url.description: Public requests return the canonical Jobicy listing URL. Commercial requests return the original application URL when available; otherwise the Jobicy listing URL.

jobSlug.description: Jobicy listing identifier formed from its ID and URL slug. Prefer id for deduplication.

companyName.description: Hiring company name; may be empty when unavailable.

companyLogo.description: Company logo URL, or false when no image is available.

jobIndustry.description: Job category display names. Use the industries taxonomy to discover filter slugs.

jobType.description: Employment type display values, such as Full-Time, Part-Time, Contract, or Internship. The available set can change.

jobGeo.description: Human-readable geographic eligibility; multiple regions may be comma-separated. Anywhere is returned when no region is specified. This is not an ISO country-code array.

jobLevel.description: Experience or seniority display value. Multiple levels may be comma-separated. Any is returned when no level is specified.

jobExcerpt.description: Supplied listing summary, or a fallback excerpt of up to 55 words.

jobDescription.description: Full job description as HTML. Sanitize before rendering in your application; it can contain a link to the Jobicy company page.

pubDate.description: Original publication date and time in UTC, formatted as ISO 8601.

salaryMin.description: Minimum salary in salaryCurrency for salaryPeriod. Omitted when unavailable.

salaryMax.description: Maximum salary in salaryCurrency for salaryPeriod. Omitted when unavailable.

salaryCurrency.description: Salary currency, normally an ISO 4217 code such as USD or EUR. Omitted when unavailable.

salaryPeriod.description: Salary interval, such as hourly, monthly, or yearly. Omitted when unavailable. Do not compare different periods or currencies without normalization.

job_request_cost.description: Commercial responses only: USD charged for this listing in this response. Normally 0.01 for a newly charged direct-link job, or 0 for a repeat or a listing without a direct application URL.

Job.description: A remote job listing. Optional salary fields are omitted when unavailable. Commercial responses add job_request_cost.

count.description: Effective page size after clamping to the supported range.

industry.description: Applied category slug after resolving legacy aliases.

cursor.description: Incoming continuation token, included only when supplied.

friendlyNotice.description: Human-readable usage or attribution notice. Do not use this text for program logic.

jobCount.description: Number of jobs returned on this page, not the total across all pages.

lastUpdate.description: Publication date of the newest job on this page, or an empty string when no jobs match. This is not a modification timestamp or synchronization watermark.

nextCursor.description: Opaque signed continuation token. Pass it unchanged and URL-encoded as cursor on the next request. Null means the traversal is complete. Do not decode, construct, or modify tokens.

hasMore.description: Whether another matching record was available when the page was generated.

jobs.description: Listings on this page; an empty array is a successful result.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code for a successful jobs response.

total_request_cost.description: Commercial responses only: total USD charged for this page. The cursor itself does not create an additional charge.

message.description: Optional message returned when no jobs match the filters.

geoSlug.description: Canonical geographic eligibility filter slug, such as usa, europe, or anywhere.

industrySlug.description: Canonical category filter slug, such as engineering or marketing.

LocationsResponse.description: Taxonomy response for get=locations. Jobs-response metadata is not included.

IndustriesResponse.description: Taxonomy response for get=industries. Jobs-response metadata is not included.

success.description: Always false for an application-level error.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Use the HTTP status for error handling; message text may change.

status.description: active: public listing open for applications. closed: expired, filled, or past its expiry date. unknown: missing/deleted ID, another post type, or unavailable to the public API. Unknown is not confirmed closure.

checkedAt.description: UTC time when this batch was evaluated. Public caches may serve a result for up to 60 seconds.

count.description: Number of unique requested IDs, including unknown IDs.

jobs.description: One result per unique ID, preserving first occurrence order. Contains no job details or ATS URLs.

total_request_cost.description: Present only for authorized requests. Status checks are free and require no wallet balance.
